create_notification: create a SARIF Notification dataclass instance with a required message and optional warning level
build_notification_with_exception: build a Notification object with an exception field for tool-level error reporting
test_notification_level: test the Notification class level field supports none note warning and error values
refactor_notification_associated_rule: refactor a Notification to associate it with a ReportingDescriptorReference via the associated_rule field
summarize_notification_locations: summarize a Notification by extracting its locations list and thread_id metadata
